x-tools.name: todo_append
x-tools.description: Append todo items / mark existing items complete. Registered through the existing DSH tool service; also attached to /btw side-question requests by this plugin.

x-session-events.reason: cache the last todo/write snapshot per session to derive append semantics

x-llm-events.reason: no TUI seam attaches tools to a /btw side question; the plugin builds its own tool-carrying request from the public waterfall
